error.message: The number of dimensions of the input image A must be 3 when the specified geometric transformation is 3-D.
Interpolation requires at least two sample points for each grid dimension.
The final column of an affine transformation matrix must consist of zeroes, except for a one in the last row.

The value of 'InterpolationMethod' is invalid. Expected InterpolationMethod to match one of these values:

'nearest', 'linear', 'cubic', 'bilinear', 'bicubic'

The input, 'bi', matched more than one valid value.
The specified transformation matrix is not valid because it is singular to working precision.
